prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Create ONE Chinese heritage atlas line plate of Yulin Caves, the photographed row of three cave portals in the pale cliff, with the irregular rock face immediately around them; omit the modern boardwalk, bushes and all unrelated cliff. Image 1 is STYLE ONLY: delicate sparse elegant fine black contours with broad white areas; never copy the Buddha in the master. Image 2 is the actual photographed SUBJECT GEOMETRY. Preserve only real visible forms and damage; do not invent figures, cave interiors or hidden features. landscape 1536×1024, centered, whole selected subject uncut with generous margins. This must be an OPAQUE BLACK-INK-ON-PURE-WHITE #FFFFFF original, every canvas pixel fully opaque; the white will be removed locally later. Keep clean light contours and only a few internal stone or robe lines. No background scene, tourists, vegetation, railings, scaffolding, sky, gray fills, hatch marks, gradient, transparency, glow, texture, color, lettering, frame or watermark.
